description: Editor tool that builds the fridge stock in the open SampleScene (the scene file is NOT edited on disk by us, the user runs the menu item and saves): shelf/wall colliders for the fridge (it has none, items would fall through), 6 FridgeStockSlot objects (2 steaks on shelf 1 = top shelf, 4 mushrooms on shelf 2), resting exactly on the shelf surface. Depends on FEAT-002.
steps: Create Assets/Editor/SetupFridgeStock.cs (+ .cs.meta, fresh guid), style of Assets/Editor/PlaceIngredientsOnCounter.cs: `#if UNITY_EDITOR`, `public static class SetupFridgeStock`, menu `Tools/Love at First Bite/Setup Fridge Stock` and `Tools/Love at First Bite/Remove Fridge Stock`, Undo support, [FridgeStock] log prefix, EditorSceneManager.MarkSceneDirty, final log telling the user to save with Ctrl+S.

Constants at the top (documented, in fridge-local units where 1 unit = 0.05 m, taken from context.json fridge_geometry_local_units): ShelfSurfaceY = { 19f, 13f, 7f } (shelf 1 = top shelf, 2, 3; comment that the user can swap them), interior X range -4..4.4 (front kept at 4.4 so static colliders never overlap the door collider that starts at x 4.5), interior Z range -6.5..6.5, clear height 5, SlotDepthX = 0.5. Stock definition list: shelf 1 -> Assets/Prefabs/Ingredients/Steak.prefab x2, shelf 2 -> Assets/Prefabs/Ingredients/Mushroom.prefab x4. Items on one shelf are spread evenly along Z over the usable width (z_i = -W/2 + (i + 0.5) * W / n).

Find the fridge root: the Transform named 'fridge' that has a child named 'fridge_door' (the mesh child is also named 'fridge', so check for the door child). If not found: Debug.LogError telling the user to open SampleScene, and return. Warn (do not abort) if its lossy scale is not about 0.05 or its rotation is not identity.

Idempotent rebuild: destroy previous 'FridgeStock' and 'Fridge_ShelfColliders' children of the fridge root (Undo.DestroyObjectImmediate) before creating new ones. Create 'Fridge_ShelfColliders' (child of the fridge root, local identity, NOT under the mesh child that owns the kinematic Rigidbody) with BoxColliders in local units: floor center (0,0.5,0) size (9.4,1,15) -> keep every box inside x <= 4.4; top slab y 24..25; back wall x -5..-4; two side walls |z| 6.5..7.5; three shelf slabs y 6..7, 12..13, 18..19 over x -4..4.4, z -6.5..6.5. Compute centers/sizes from the constants, not magic numbers. These colliders are static (no Rigidbody).

Create 'FridgeStock' (child of the fridge root, identity). For each stock item create a child 'Slot_<Prefab name>_<n>' with a FridgeStockSlot (Undo.AddComponent). To place it: temporarily PrefabUtility.InstantiatePrefab the item prefab at the target XZ (yaw 0), compute the combined Renderer bounds, set the slot WORLD position so the item's lowest point is 0.002 m above the shelf surface world Y (surface local Y -> world via the fridge root TransformPoint) i.e. slot.y = surfaceWorldY + 0.002 - (bounds.min.y - instance.position.y); then DestroyImmediate the temporary instance. Set m_Prefab and m_ClearRadius (= max(bounds.extents.x, bounds.extents.z) + 0.02) via SerializedObject (leave m_RespawnDelay at its 5 s default, do not hardcode another value). Warn with the item name when: the item's height exceeds the shelf clear height, its bounds leave the interior X/Z range, or two neighbouring items' bounds overlap on the shelf.

Sanity warnings (do not abort): the prefab files must exist (error + skip item otherwise); Steak/Mushroom source meshes not Read/Write enabled (ModelImporter.isReadable false for AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(meshFilter.sharedMesh)) -> warn to run `Tools > Love at First Bite > Make Ingredient Meshes Readable` so the knife can slice them; an XRInteractionManager is missing in the scene.

Selection.activeGameObject = FridgeStock root, Debug.Log a summary: how many slots placed, shelf world heights, reminder: save the scene, then press Play, open the fridge door, take an item and watch it reappear after 5 s.

Compile the editor script with the extended compile_check.ps1 (editor step from FEAT-001) and fix errors. Re-read the script once for logic errors (local vs world coordinates, scale 0.05, Undo order), since it cannot be executed here.

Add a short Romanian section 'Frigider cu stoc si respawn' to Documentation/Sprint_W8.md at the end of Task 5 (Gheoca Razvan, frigider cu usa), or at the end of the file if Task 5 section is hard to locate: what the system does (2 carne pe prima gratar/tava de sus, 4 ciuperci pe a doua, respawn la 5 s in acelasi loc, fara duplicate), the menu item to run, where to change the shelf/delay. Keep the file encoding as it is (read it first; if the existing text shows mojibake in your tool, append with the same encoding via a method that does not rewrite existing lines).
acceptance_criteria: Assets/Editor/SetupFridgeStock.cs compiles with 0 errors in the extended compile check
The tool creates colliders for floor, top, back, sides and 3 shelves that do not extend past local x 4.4

The tool creates exactly 6 slots: 2 with Steak.prefab on the top shelf (surface local y 19), 4 with Mushroom.prefab on the next shelf (local y 13), each resting 2 mm above the surface, each with m_RespawnDelay left at the 5 s default
Running the tool twice does not create duplicates
